title: Legacy UFO program secrecy rooted in the Manhattan Project and the 1954 Atomic Energy Act

tellings.quote: specifically legacy programs starting with the same secrecy mechanisms as the Manhattan project and the 1954 atomic energy agreement birthing a lot of the secrecy behind uh UFO legacy program classification and controls.

plain: The secret, long-running government UFO programs, called legacy programs, began with the same secrecy rules as the Manhattan Project, the wartime effort that built the atomic bomb, and the 1954 Atomic Energy Act, a US law that locked down nuclear information. A commentator who goes by UAPGerb lays this out, drawing on what a witness named David Grusch said in an interview with the podcaster Joe Rogan. It would explain why UFO secrets are classified so tightly.
